$comment: HLVS V2 Capability Registry — machine-readable canonical baseline of every audited HLVS capability, its real implementation, maturity and recommended action. Persisted under CEO approval on 2026-08-13 from the read-only HLVS V2 Master Capability & Architecture Audit. Companion prose: .hlbos/audits/2026-08-13-hlvs-master-audit.md. Code + database + deployment evidence are authoritative over prose/planning docs. Do not inflate maturity: BUILT != MERGED != APPLIED != DEPLOYED != VERIFIED_FUNCTIONAL. Unknown stays UNKNOWN.
generatedBy: Claude (AI engineer) — read-only Master Capability & Architecture Audit
authorityRule: Repository code, live database introspection, and deployment configuration are authoritative. Planning docs, READMEs and milestone prose are NOT — where they conflict, code/DB/deploy wins and the conflict is recorded as documentation drift.

database.dataBearing: seed-and-vocabulary-only; no customer/opportunity data (all vstudio and hlvs operational tables 0 rows as of 2026-08-13)

maturityVocabulary.DEPLOYED: Running in a deployed environment (may be staging/preview), not necessarily verified functional.
maturityVocabulary.APPLIED: Database migration applied to canonical production; schema objects exist (may be empty).
maturityVocabulary.MERGED: Code merged into canonical repo main.
maturityVocabulary.BUILT: Code exists and passes checks/tests but is not merged and/or not deployed.
maturityVocabulary.OPEN_PR: Exists only in an open, unmerged pull request.
maturityVocabulary.PARTIAL: Some layers exist (e.g. schema applied + seed) but the capability is not end-to-end usable.
maturityVocabulary.STUB: Placeholder / reference scaffold only; no functional behavior.
maturityVocabulary.PLANNED: Intended by architecture; no implementation yet.
maturityVocabulary.DUPLICATE: Overlaps another implementation and should be consolidated.

maturityLadder: BUILT != MERGED; MERGED != APPLIED; APPLIED != DEPLOYED; DEPLOYED != VERIFIED_FUNCTIONAL.

architecturalDistinctions.$comment: These four HLVS-named / adjacent surfaces MUST NOT be collapsed into one implementation merely because their names overlap.
architecturalDistinctions.vstudio: Executive / Opportunity Intelligence. Schema vstudio.* + apps/venture-studio + @hl-bos/venture-studio. Captures opportunities, evaluates, recommends, records the authoritative CEO decision, previews factory readiness. System-of-record for OPPORTUNITIES.
architecturalDistinctions.hlvs: Software Factory system-of-record. Schema hlvs.* (migration 0025) + supabase/functions/hlvs-factory-worker + _shared/hlvs. Products, blueprints, software-creation-orders, build packages, conformance, development runs. System-of-record for the BUILD/factory pipeline. NOT the opportunity store.
architecturalDistinctions.@hl-bos/catalog: Reusable capability/module/reuse/factory/portfolio MODELING layer (pure logic + in-code registries). Powers reuse & duplicate analysis, factory assembly readiness, portfolio/application registry. A library, not a system-of-record.
architecturalDistinctions.@hl-bos/transformation-intelligence: SEPARATE Business Transformation Intelligence capability (HL-BTI). Contains an HLVS-named surface (src/hlvs.ts: SoftwareOpportunity / OpportunityVerdict) that bridges 'this customer needs X' to 'the Factory can assemble X'. This is a transformation-assessment -> software-opportunity rollup, NOT the vstudio opportunity funnel. OVERLAP REQUIRES CLARIFICATION.
architecturalDistinctions.hld_bti: Herman Legacy Digital (apps/herman-legacy-digital) + BTI/BTIC/BTDI lineage: an adjacent transformation/business-intelligence customer-facing product. It is the intended HOST of /HLVS but is NOT a replacement for Venture Studio.

mandatoryPreflightProtocol.$comment: Governance rule established by this registry. Enforce before any future HLVS design or implementation.
mandatoryPreflightProtocol.rule: Before designing or implementing any HLVS work:
steps: 3. Check relevant open PRs (especially #26 B2 pipeline, #23/#24/#27 docs).
4. Check reusable HL-BOS capabilities (identity, tenancy, audit, ai gateway, events, integrations, comms, billing, graph).
5. Classify the proposed work as one of: REUSE, EXTEND, CONSOLIDATE, NET_NEW.
mandatoryPreflightProtocol.netNewRule: NET_NEW requires explicit evidence that no reusable implementation exists. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — search first.

Apply migration 0031 (transformation intake) to canonical production — in main, UNAPPLIED.
Deploy the Venture Studio app + expose vstudio over the API + choose VSTUDIO_TENANT_ID.
Choose application hosting (no Vercel/Coolify chosen) and deploy edge-function workers (0 deployed today).
Authorize any autonomous Software Factory codegen (hlvs order_status implies it; NOT authorized).
